results.snippet: California Memorial Stadium was designed by campus architect John Galen Howard and constructed in 1923. Listed on the National Register of Historic Places, it is a behemoth of a historic structure with a total square of 400,000 square feet. results.title: California Memorial Stadium | American Football Wiki | Fandom
results.snippet: California Memorial Stadium is an outdoor football stadium on the campus of the University of California in Berkeley. Commonly known as Memorial Stadium, it is the home field for the University of California Golden Bears of the Pacific-12 Conference.
